integrity: The symbolic proof is the infinite family argument; a separate standard-library checker tests all 65536 bipartite 4-by-4 edge sets and the 1-by-1 through 4-by-4 complete-fiber enumeration. No independent audit or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies projected minimal nonmodels of one split dependence disjunction; it is not a classification of all dependence formulas or of arbitrary implication problems. Literature equivalence under graph-cover terminology remains a residual possibility.
title: Six minimal certificates for disjunctive functional dependencies
